details: Global Time is an interactive web application that combines a 3D Earth globe with satellite observations and geological exploration. Users can rotate, zoom in, and explore the planet through two distinct modes: Geological Time, which visualizes Earth's evolution across different geological periods, and Satellite Observation Time, which displays modern satellite data and environmental changes. In the Observatory, users can explore SAR phenomena such as flooding, vegetation changes, wildfires, ground deformation, and glacier movement through interactive layers and real satellite observation footprints. The application connects to NASA Earthdata CMR, NASA EONET, and the Alaska Satellite Facility (ASF) Search GeoJSON API to retrieve satellite metadata, geographic footprints, and natural hazard information. It also includes a Before/After SAR comparator that allows users to examine radar imagery from different acquisition dates. The globe uses geographic data from Natural Earth to display modern continents, while geological reconstructions and scientific information help users understand Earth's ancient history. Built with React, TypeScript, HTML5 Canvas, Node.js, and Express, Global Time transforms complex Earth observation data into an accessible and interactive experience for students, educators, and anyone interested in understanding how our planet changes over time.
